response.content: Transformer (deep learning): widely adopted for training large language models (LLMs) on large (language) datasets. Modern transformer designs are commonly grouped into encoder-only | Generative pre-trained transformer: pre-training to the transformer architecture, introducing the GPT-1 model in 2018. The company has since released many bigger GPT models. The chatbot ChatGPT | Noam Shazeer: intelligence and deep learning, particularly in the development of transformer models and natural language processing. He lives in Palo Alto, California
